claude.rationale: This was a whole-company merger: the entire CH2M legal vehicle survived as a wholly-owned Jacobs subsidiary, so the customer-facing services (T4) crossed the boundary together with the operations and people that produce them (no carve-out, "the entire corporate entity — not a carved-out business unit — was the transaction's subject"), giving gap_45 = 0. The people/organization (T6) moved coherently alongside the operational substrate: non-union Continuing Employees carried forward under contractual pay/benefit-continuity terms and union employees remained under their CBAs, so process and organization transferred together — gap_56 = 0. Replacement of CH2M's board and named executives (T1 replace) is an intent-tier change, not a T5-vs-T6 structural mismatch. No transition-services or shared-substrate agreement is described because none was needed in a whole-company merger, hence gap_mitigated = NA.

grok.rationale: The deal was a whole-company reverse triangular merger in which CH2M survived intact as a wholly-owned Jacobs subsidiary, so the customer-facing services (T4) and the operations that deliver them (T5) crossed together with no carved-out product-vs-process split at closing (gap_45=0). Rank-and-file Continuing Employees and CBA-covered employees were carried forward under contractual pay/benefit continuity while only the board and named officers were replaced, so processes did not transfer without the operating organization (gap_56=0); the DEFM14A expressly describes no TSA or shared-substrate bridge because none was structurally required.

openai.rationale: The whole-company merger transferred CH2M’s customer-facing engineering and related services together with the surviving legal entity and its operations, rather than carving the products away from their operating substrate, so gap_45 is 0 [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-338957, DEFM14A cover letter, “Summary,” and “Jacobs’ Reasons for the Merger”]. Rank-and-file employees were carried forward under contractual compensation and benefit-continuity provisions, while CH2M’s board and named executive officers were replaced by new directors and officers; this supports a partial organizational transfer but does not document processes crossing without an organization aligned to run them, so gap_56 is 0 [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-338957, DEFM14A “The Merger Agreement — Employee Benefits”; SEC accession 0001104659-17-073715, Form 8-K Item 5.02].
